sloka: शिंशुपामलकीजम्ब्वो याश्चान्या: काननेषु ता: ।मालती मल्लिका जातिर्याश्चान्या: कानने लता: ॥ २.९१.५०॥
transliteration: śiṁśupāmalakījambvo yāścānyā: kānaneṣu tā: ।mālatī mallikā jātiryāścānyā: kānane latā: ॥ 2.91.50॥

translations.english: Thereafter pine, palmyra, tilaka, and naktamala trees were transformed into hunchbacks and dwarfs and moved about in great delight.
